title: Narrative direction
purpose: Keep every scene causally linked and changing something, and keep setups, payoffs and twists honest. The twist ledger lives in filmspec.json (setups/payoffs), never in story/continuity.json, which stays the canonical physical state.
use_cases: Writing the beat sheet before G0: each beat says what the character wants, what blocks it and what is different after.
Planting a setup (an object, a line, a habit) and recording where it pays off, so a later cut cannot orphan it.
Checking a rough cut for narrative regression: after a re-edit, does every payoff still come after its setup?
Placing an easter egg: a setup with `payoff_later` naming a future episode, so it is a promise, not noise.
anti_patterns: Scenes connected by 'and then' instead of 'therefore' or 'but': events follow without causing each other.
A twist with no earlier evidence; the audience cannot re-read it, so it feels arbitrary.
A payoff cut ahead of its setup during a re-edit (narrative regression).
Stakes stated in dialogue but never shown in picture.
A character arc that changes in one line of dialogue instead of across choices.
Twist notes written into story/continuity.json, which then leak into keyframe prompts.

checks.measure: every payoff names a setup that exists and comes in the same or an earlier scene; every setup has a payoff or `payoff_later`
reviewer writes the scene chain as 'X, therefore/but Y' and marks each 'and then'
the user watches the scene and says what changed
